props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Centralized security monitoring and telemetry correlation architecture.

props.name: data-entity

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Controls governing system monitoring, continuous assessment, and analysis of security-relevant data.

metadata.remarks: The Security Monitoring pattern defines continuous observation and correlation of telemetry to establish situational awareness. This pattern does not perform threat detection, alerting, or response actions. Its outputs inform downstream analytics and decision-making.

components.title: Telemetry Ingestion and Normalization
components.description: Ingestion, normalization, and preparation of telemetry from diverse sources to enable cross-system monitoring.

props.name: attack-tactics
props.remarks: Monitoring focuses on Initial Access and Persistence behaviors that often manifest as subtle system changes.

props.name: attack-techniques
props.remarks: These techniques require telemetry normalization across authentication and persistence mechanisms.

props.name: d3fend-mitigations
props.remarks: This component operationalizes D3FEND telemetry collection and aggregation mitigations.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Security-relevant events are aggregated and prepared for monitoring analysis per SP 800-92 Section 4.

components.title: Event Correlation and Pattern Observation
components.description: Correlation of events across systems to identify suspicious patterns deserving further analytic attention.

props.name: attack-tactics
props.remarks: Correlation targets Discovery and Lateral Movement behaviors that only emerge across multiple telemetry sources.

props.name: attack-techniques
props.remarks: These techniques require multi-source correlation to surface patterns of adversary activity.

props.name: d3fend-mitigations
props.remarks: This component implements D3FEND correlation mitigations to surface activity patterns without asserting maliciousness.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Monitoring correlates system behavior to identify potentially suspicious activity patterns.

components.title: Security Situational Awareness
components.description: Presentation of correlated monitoring outputs to support analyst awareness and downstream analysis.

props.name: attack-tactics
props.remarks: Situational awareness supports detection of Command and Control patterns over time.

props.name: d3fend-mitigations
props.remarks: This component operationalizes D3FEND visibility mitigations by exposing correlated system behavior.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Monitoring outputs support continuous assessment and risk awareness.
